According to Srikanth of COMK, the Northeast Monsoon 2026 remains active after exceptional rains between October 16 and 18, taking Tamil Nadu’s seasonal rainfall to 13% above normal. Interacting circulations may bring widespread rain to South and West Tamil Nadu, with Chennai and North Coastal Tamil Nadu expecting showers over the next two days. KTCC may receive above-normal rainfall this week, followed by a possible temporary lull.
